description: Golden table of Financial IQ scoring v3, variant v3c-i5: the v3c-i5 column of evaluation/out/iq_v3_golden.json (produced by evaluation/iq_v3/scoring.py, the Python reference with decimal arithmetic), copied on 25 Nov 2026, regenerated on 26 Nov 2026 (2,000 TL expense floor of the reserve and runway, intermediate expenses_reserve) (52 cases, incl.
